design.decision: Keep length in a side suit and cash its low cards late after the honors fall, instead of drawing trumps first; your team's honors can still be trumped, so lead them early and save low cards for the end.
design.opponent: Shows up when an opponent's ruff fails to beat a [7]; opponents switch from trumping to holding high cards of the team's long suits.
design.rationale: Turns the Low Cards plan, winning through length after the honors are gone, into a reliable line of play. Its standalone value is protecting most of the hand from ruffs. It is distinct from the uncommon [A] and [♦] versions because it reverses the usual priority between honors and low cards.
design.draftText: Your team's [2]s through [10]s can't be trumped

critic.concerns: A fifth member of the untrumpable family (ua-aces-, ua-diamonds-, ra-team-, rb-side-); the shield only matters when a low card is winning its suit, which is late and rare.
